meta.title: Knockout and Dutch auctions refuse multi-product rounds without fast bidding
gaps: The case requires multiple auction rounds or events, but exactly one fresh setup recipe is allowed.
The available auction setup recipe creates only one line item; no operation can add a second line.
Fast bidding cannot be enabled or disabled through the available setup fields or operations.
The available recipes and operations cannot create a knockout auction and a Dutch auction made from a plain pricing round for comparison.
The expected refusal and publication outcomes for the three distinct rounds cannot be tested in one plan.
